newsitem.title: USA: Nastech vitamin approved by FDA.
newsitem.headline: Nastech vitamin approved by FDA.

text.p: Nastech Pharmaceutical Co Inc said on Thursday it received marketing clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for its Nascobal Gel vitamin B-12.
The product, which is administered through the nose, is a treatment for vitamin B-12 deficiencies, particularly in patients with pernicious anemia, Nastech said.

Vitamin B-12 deficiency has a number of causes, including malabsorption of vitamin B-12 resulting from structural or functional damage to the gastrointestinal system and dietary deficiency of vitamin B-12 in strict vegetarians.
Nastech said Nascobal can treat patients requiring more than the normal amount of vitamin B-12 because of pregnancy, or hepatic or renal disease.
It is estimated that one percent of the U.S. population, or 2.75 million people, will develop pernicious anemia in their lifetimes, the company said.
Also, vitamin B-12 deficiencies are found in up to 10 percent of patients over 60 years old. Many of them require monthly injections of the vitamin, the company said.
